question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is ''**survive**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the passage suggests the character has a realization as he falls asleep, but he is uncertain if he will remember this realization in the morning.
 
• “**Survive**” is the most appropriate choice because it implies the realization must endure through the transition from night to day.
 
• Other options like “proliferate,” “install,” and “fabricate” do not fit the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage:* He looks out of the window at the (1)* *falling__* *snow, then turns and takes his wife in his arms, feeling grateful to be here even as he wonders what he is going to do with his life in strictly practical terms. For years, he had (2)* *__trained__** himself to do one thing, and he did it well, but he doesn't know whether he wants to keep doing it for the rest of his life, for that matter, whether anyone will let him. He is still worrying when they go to bed.*

*They've been learning to get by with less, and they'll keep learning. It seems to him as if they're taking a course in loss lately. And as he feels himself falling asleep he has an (3)* *__insight__* *he believes is important, which he hopes he will remember in the morning, although it is one of those thoughts that seldom (4)* *__survive__* *translation to the language of daylight hours.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• “**Survive**” (बच पाना) : Correct as it fits the context of enduring through the night.
 
• “**Proliferate**” (फैलना): Incorrect as it means to increase rapidly and doesn't fit the context.
 
• “**Install**” (स्थापित करना): Incorrect as it means to set up something, unrelated to thoughts.
 
• “**Fabricate**” (गढ़ना): Incorrect as it means to invent and is not suitable for the context of a fleeting thought.
